Return & Refund Policy

Last updated: November 17, 2026

This Return Policy applies to all purchases made through Tava Labs (tavalabs.app) and forms part of our Terms & Conditions.

All Sales Are Final

All sales are final and no refund will be issued. As stated in Section 7 ("Return Policy") of our Terms & Conditions: "All sales are final and no refund will be issued."

By placing an order through tavalabs.app, you acknowledge and agree to this policy. Please review your order carefully before completing your purchase.

Questions

If you have any questions about this policy or about an order you have placed, please contact us at talia@tavalabs.app.
